outcome: Composite outcome of death or major morbidity (bronchopulmonary dysplasia, necrotizing enterocolitis stage >=2, periventricular leukomalacia, severe intraventricular hemorrhage, severe retinopathy of prematurity)
cohort: The study included 37,603 preterm infants born at <=24 weeks gestational age in the United States who survived at least 1 day of life.
finding: Survival to discharge among preterm infants <=24 weeks gestational age significantly increased, while death or major morbidities significantly decreased from 2009 to 2018.
